request.initial_prompt: If Moses, Cyrus, Theseus, and Romulus had been unarmed they could not have enforced their constitutions for long—as happened in our time to Fra Girolamo Savonarola, who was ruined with his new order of things immediately the multitude believed in him no longer, and he had no means of keeping steadfast those who believed or of making the unbelievers to believe. Therefore such as these have great difficulties in consummating their enterprise, for all their dangers are in the ascent, yet with ability they will overcome them; but when these are overcome, and those who envied them their success are exterminated, they will begin to be respected, and they will continue afterwards powerful, secure, honoured, and happy.

raw_segments.text: If Moses, Cyrus, Theseus, and Romulus had been unarmed they could not have enforced their
constitutions for long—as happened in our time to Fra Girolamo Savonarola, who was ruined
with his new order of things immediately the multitude believed in him no longer, and he
had no means of keeping steadfast those who believed or of making the unbelievers to believe.
Therefore such as these have great difficulties in consummating their enterprise, for all their
dangers are in the ascent, yet with ability they will overcome them. But when these are
overcome, and those who envied them their success are exterminated, they will begin
to be respected, and they will continue afterwards powerful, secure, honoured, and happy.
